title: PAR-134 DIMSTYLE DIMTFILLCLR DWG CMC metadata retention
scope: Retain method, RGB, optional color-name, and color-book-name for the R2007+ DIMSTYLE DIMTFILLCLR CMC field
Emit method-specific C0/C1/C2/C3 payloads and optional strings through the bounded detached string stream
Verify wire order, parse retention, subsequent BS fields, copy/reset, and refusal before output for unsupported or unrepresentable state

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §20.4.68 defines table-record DIMCLRD/E/T and the distinct R2007+ DIMTFILLCLR as CMC. This receipt specifically covers DIMTFILLCLR retention; the 2026-10-22 correction receipt covers the three other fields. §2.11 defines the generic CMC method, RGB payload, and optional name/book flags and TV strings. The §9 header-system variables with similar names are different fields.

dxfMappingAudit.finding: The Autodesk DIMSTYLE DXF reference lists the dimension-index color fields (groups 176–178), but does not establish a DIMTFILLCLR mapping for truecolor/name/book companions. No mapping to generic 420/430/431 groups is inferred.

localSource.finding: DIMTFILLCLR now retains scalar, method, optional RGB, flags, color name, and color-book name. Parsing uses the bounded CMC reader. Writing validates representable C0/C1/C2/C3 state before output and sends flagged strings through a distinct detached string buffer.
localSource.compatibility: Appended public fields change DRW_Dimstyle size; downstream consumers must rebuild. No virtual interface changed.

generatedControls.finding: Generated C0 ByLayer with name/book, C1 ByBlock with name, C2 black RGB with name/book, and C3 ACI with book cases are independently walked for string-stream order, CMC method/flags/payload, and following BS fields. Production parsing retains the state. Copy, assignment, reset, unsupported C4 refusal, and missing detached-string refusal are covered.
generatedControls.limit: Generated vectors establish local codec consistency only; they are not producer-authored or native-consumer evidence.

productionSummary: Append DIMTFILLCLR RGB, method, flags, name, and book-name companions and preserve them through copy/assignment/reset.
Capture the bounded CMC payload and optional strings on parse.
Write explicit supported CMC methods and optional strings through the detached stream.
Reject unsupported methods, inconsistent scalar/RGB/flag state, and named output without a distinct detached stream before emitting the record prefix.
